justifications.label: SLAM's theoretical reliability is gated by the practical linearization assumption that breaks under high uncertainty

slam-vo-and-optical-flow-triple-instanti.text: SLAM-VO forming a complementary local-global integration pair mirroring underdetermination-generated structure AND VO-registration dichotomies converging on underdetermination structure together with optical flow's local-global complementarity from the aperture problem constitute a triple instantiation of underdetermination generating complementary method families across all spatial estimation domains.

justifications.label: Three independent spatial estimation domains (SLAM/VO, registration/VO, optical flow) all exhibit underdetermination-driven complementary dichotomies, strengthening the universality claim through triple convergence.

slam-vo-complementary-local-global-integ.text: SLAM's joint pose-and-map estimation complements VO's six-stage incremental pipeline: VO provides frame-to-frame motion estimation through its canonical stages (acquisition, correction, feature matching, outlier removal, motion estimation, trackpoint repopulation) but inherently accumulates drift, while SLAM adds global consistency through loop closure and joint optimization — together they illustrate how incremental local estimation and global correction can be combined to address cumulative error in spatial reasoning.

justifications.label: VO and SLAM form complementary local-global spatial reasoning requiring integration

slam-vo-dichotomy-mirrors-underdetermina.text: The complementary relationship between SLAM and VO — where VO provides local frame-to-frame estimation while SLAM adds global consistency — appears consistent with the pattern where underdetermination generates complementary dichotomies that require integration for resolution. This suggests the SLAM/VO relationship may be an instance of underdetermination-driven complementary dichotomy, where spatial correspondence's underdetermination contributed to the development of complementary local and global approaches whose integration addresses cumulative estimation error. However, this identification rests on structural analogy with a limited set of other domains (notably optical flow), and the parallel may not be exact.

justifications.label: SLAM/VO complementarity is a direct instance of underdetermination generating dichotomies resolved by integration

slam-vo-loop-closure-complementary-spati.text: SLAM's joint pose-and-map estimation with loop closure for drift correction and VO's inherent cumulative drift constitute a complementary spatial estimation architecture: VO provides efficient frame-to-frame motion estimation while SLAM adds global consistency through revisitation detection using feature-based recognition.

justifications.label: SLAM and VO form a complementary local-global architecture addressing the drift-consistency tradeoff

slam-vo-loop-closure-complementary-triad.text: VO provides incremental motion estimation that inherently drifts over time, SLAM jointly estimates pose and map for global consistency, and loop closure corrects accumulated drift using techniques such as bag-of-words over SIFT features for place recognition — together these components address complementary aspects of long-term trajectory estimation.

justifications.label: Three localization mechanisms form a mutually completing triad: local estimation, global optimization, and recognition-mediated correction

smote-and-augmentation-jointly-validate-.text: SMOTE's validation of representation primacy through feature-space interpolation and augmentation/batch-norm's complementary regularization role together demonstrate that effective training operates in representation space rather than raw data space across both sample generation and regularization — unless the global-local tension in SSL (where global and dense feature quality can diverge) implies that feature-space operations may degrade local spatial structure even when improving global representations.

justifications.label: Feature-space training validity is jointly confirmed by augmentation and SMOTE unless representation quality diverges across spatial scales

smote-and-focal-loss-bracket-class-imbal.text: SMOTE's feature-space interpolation validating representation over pixels AND SMOTE plus focal loss constituting dual class-imbalance strategies together reveal that class imbalance is addressed through a two-level strategy in CV: at the data level (SMOTE's synthetic minority generation in feature space, validating that the right level of abstraction for data manipulation is learned representation) and at the loss level (focal loss's attention-like weighting of hard examples) — complementary responses operating at different points in the training pipeline.

justifications.label: Data-level and loss-level class imbalance strategies complement each other and both validate representation-level reasoning

smote-and-focal-loss-bracket-class-imbal.text: SMOTE and focal loss bracketing class imbalance at data and loss levels AND augmentation/batch-norm's complementary regularization role together suggest that training robustness in learned-paradigm CV involves at least two complementary layers: data-level rebalancing (SMOTE interpolation) paired with loss-level reweighting (focal loss), and training-regime regularization (augmentation + batch norm) — each addressing a different aspect of training instability. Whether these layers operate fully without interference remains an empirical question rather than a guaranteed property.

justifications.label: Combines the data/loss-level class-imbalance strategies with the training-regime regularization strategies, revealing a three-layer robustness architecture for learned-paradigm training.

smote-and-focal-loss-dual-class-imbalanc.text: Class imbalance in CV is addressed through two complementary strategies operating at different pipeline stages: data-level rebalancing (SMOTE interpolating synthetic minority samples in feature space) and loss-level reweighting (RetinaNet's focal loss down-weighting easy/majority examples during training) — one reshapes the data distribution, the other reshapes the loss landscape.

justifications.label: Two orthogonal approaches to the same class imbalance problem, operating at data vs. loss level

smote-feature-space-validates-representa.text: SMOTE's choice to interpolate in feature space rather than pixel space and the representation-primacy thesis supported by neural rendering convergence (Plenoxels/3DGS discarding MLPs) suggest a cross-era parallel: both classical augmentation and learned rendering arrived at solutions where the choice of representation — rather than raw pixel/voxel data or network architecture — appears to be a primary load-bearing element for their respective tasks, though they operated under different constraints and objectives.

justifications.label: Classical and learned eras independently discover primacy of representation over raw data

smote-interpolates-in-feature-space.text: SMOTE generates synthetic minority class samples by interpolating between nearest neighbors along line segments in feature space, not pixel space — addressing class imbalance without duplicating existing samples.

sparse-autoencoder-sparsity-methods.text: Sparse autoencoders enforce sparsity via either hard k-sparse top-k selection (zeroing gradients for inactive units, generalizing ReLU) or soft regularization (KL divergence or L1/L2 penalty), and may have more hidden units than inputs.

spatial-framework-doubly-stable.text: CV's complete spatial interpretation framework would rest on doubly-stable foundations — grounded in convergently validated dual pillars (geometric pipeline + CNN revolution) AND supported by a paradigm-resilient feature-reconstruction pathway whose differential-mathematical substrate persists across paradigm shifts — if the linearization assumptions underpinning the correspondence pipeline didn't break under large displacements.

justifications.label: Pillar validation and mathematical paradigm-invariance provide independent stability guarantees — gated because both assume the mathematical pipeline's linearization holds

spatial-framework-grounded-in-validated-.text: CV's complete spatial interpretation framework — deep learning unifying geometric reconstruction (WHERE) with semantic understanding (WHAT) — is not merely theoretically unified but empirically grounded, because its two constituent pillars (the geometric math-to-reconstruction pipeline and the CNN-driven detection-to-scene-understanding revolution) have been independently validated by standardized metrics.

justifications.label: the spatial framework's completeness claim gains empirical weight when both of its constituent pillars are shown to be independently validated

spatial-framework-on-inverse-created-ter.text: CNN's catalytic role in completing the spatial interpretation framework may have been facilitated by the doubly-structured evolutionary terrain that the inverse problem helped shape: the inverse nature contributed to layered stability (mathematical foundations persisting beneath paradigm shifts) where CNN's architectural universality could substantially leverage existing foundations while absorbing rather than discarding prior approaches — suggesting the inverse problem may have helped create conditions conducive to its own practical resolution.

justifications.label: Inverse problem created the layered terrain that made CNN's catalytic spatial-framework role possible

spectral-avoidance-as-classical-cv-engin.text: Classical CV feature detectors systematically avoid explicit eigendecomposition while relying on spectral properties — Harris using det/trace proxies for the structure tensor, SIFT using Hessian trace/determinant for edge rejection — establishing eigenvalue-free spectral analysis as a deliberate engineering pattern trading mathematical purity for computational efficiency.

justifications.label: Eigenvalue avoidance is not coincidental but a systematic classical CV pattern, enabled by gradient analysis serving as the universal primitive

ssd-optimal-same-modality-gaussian-noise.text: Sum of Squared Distances (SSD) is the optimal similarity metric for same-modality image registration with Gaussian noise; multi-modal registration requires mutual information or learned representations like CoMIRs.

ssl-achieves-learned-paradigm-training-s.text: SSL extending absorption to the training methodology itself AND SSL methods spanning the full collapse-prevention spectrum (contrastive, non-contrastive, predictive masking, covariance-based) together demonstrate that the learned paradigm has achieved training self-sufficiency — it can now generate its own supervisory signals through a mature, diversified set of approaches rather than depending on external label provision.

justifications.label: Absorptive extension to supervision + mature collapse-prevention spectrum = training self-sufficiency

ssl-and-augmentation-jointly-achieve-tra.text: SSL's achievement of training self-sufficiency (generating supervisory signals from data structure alone) AND augmentation/batch-norm's complementary implicit regularization together suggest the learned paradigm has made significant progress toward training autonomy — it can both generate supervision AND benefit from implicit regularization without explicit external intervention, addressing two major dependencies on human engineering in the training pipeline.

justifications.label: SSL provides self-supervision while augmentation/batch-norm provide self-regularization — together, training autonomy

ssl-and-diffusion-training-innovations-j.text: SSL and diffusion independently eliminating different training dependencies (external labels vs sequential noise application) AND SSL achieving comprehensive training self-sufficiency across the full collapse-prevention spectrum jointly demonstrate that the learned paradigm has systematically reduced major external training dependencies across complementary dimensions: SSL removes the need for human annotation, and diffusion's reparameterization removes the need for sequential forward-process simulation — together bracketing the training-strategy innovation spectrum by each eliminating a different form of computational dependency.

justifications.label: SSL and diffusion jointly eliminate complementary training dependencies achieving comprehensive autonomy

ssl-and-diffusion-training-strategies-br.text: SSL generating supervisory signals from data structure alone (achieving training self-sufficiency without labels) AND diffusion's reparameterization trick enabling direct one-step sampling of noisy versions during training (avoiding sequential forward-process simulation) represent two distinct strategies for removing computational dependencies from the training process: SSL removes dependence on external supervision while diffusion's direct sampling removes dependence on sequential noise application — each achieving training efficiency by eliminating a different prerequisite that would otherwise constrain the training pipeline.

justifications.label: SSL and diffusion independently eliminate different training dependencies (external labels vs sequential noise process)

ssl-collapse-avoidance-spectrum.text: SSL methods can be grouped by how they avoid representation collapse: contrastive methods (e.g., SimCLR, MoCo) use explicit negative pairs to push apart representations, non-contrastive methods (e.g., BYOL, DirectPred) rely on architectural asymmetry such as an asymmetric predictor and stop-gradient, and covariance-regularized methods (e.g., Barlow Twins, VICReg) use statistical constraints on the embedding covariance matrix — representing distinct design choices along the axes of negative-sample dependence and architectural complexity.

justifications.label: Organizing principle — three structurally distinct solutions to the same collapse problem reveal the design space's axes

ssl-collapse-prevention-and-adversarial-.text: SSL's three structurally distinct collapse-prevention mechanisms (contrastive negatives, architectural asymmetry, covariance constraints) AND GANs' adversarial self-supervision (opposed to SSL's cooperative self-supervision) together cover a substantial portion of the self-supervision design space along two axes: how training signal is generated (adversarial vs. cooperative) and how degenerate solutions are avoided (three independent mechanisms) — suggesting broad, though not necessarily exhaustive, exploration of the structural possibilities for label-free training.

justifications.label: Adversarial/cooperative axis combined with three collapse-prevention mechanisms exhausts label-free training design space

ssl-collapse-prevention-defines-method-t.text: SSL methods are fundamentally taxonomized by their strategy for preventing representational collapse: contrastive methods use explicit negative pairs to push apart dissimilar representations, while non-contrastive methods use architectural asymmetries (momentum networks, stop-gradient) to break symmetry without negative examples.

justifications.label: Collapse prevention mechanism is the defining structural axis of the SSL design space

ssl-collapse-prevention-spans-three-stru.text: Self-supervised learning independently discovered three structurally distinct mechanisms for preventing representation collapse: explicit negative pairs pushing representations apart (contrastive), architectural asymmetry breaking symmetry without negatives (BYOL/DirectPred), and covariance constraints decorrelating embedding dimensions (Barlow Twins/VICReg).

justifications.label: Three independent collapse-prevention solutions span the SSL methodology space along the negative-pair-dependence axis

ssl-complementary-collapse-solutions.text: Contrastive SSL (using both positive and negative pairs) and non-contrastive SSL (using only positive pairs with architectural asymmetry) represent two distinct approaches to avoiding representation collapse — one through explicit repulsion via negative pairs, the other through structural mechanisms like asymmetric predictors and stop-gradients — suggesting complementary strategies for learning useful representations without labels.

justifications.label: Contrastive/non-contrastive dichotomy exemplifies complementary solutions to underdetermined collapse prevention

ssl-contrastive-positive-and-negative-pa.text: Contrastive SSL uses both positive and negative example pairs, minimizing distance between positive pairs and maximizing distance between negative pairs; InfoNCE loss uses one positive sample and N-1 negative samples in a softmax-style ratio based on Noise Contrastive Estimation.

ssl-dichotomy-and-diffusion-overdetermin.text: SSL's complementary collapse-prevention solutions (contrastive repulsion vs non-contrastive asymmetry) and diffusion's multiple equivalent mathematical formalisms and prediction targets both illustrate patterns consistent with underdetermination's generative power operating at the training methodology level — suggesting that the same force that gives rise to complementary method pairs may also give rise to mathematical redundancy within individual methods, both as responses to ill-posed optimization.

justifications.label: SSL dichotomy and diffusion overdetermination are complementary manifestations of underdetermination at the training level

ssl-dichotomy-depth-spans-three-independ.text: Self-supervised learning exhibits complementary dichotomies across at least two dimensions: collapse-prevention strategy (contrastive repulsion vs non-contrastive asymmetry) and prediction target (pixel-space reconstruction vs representation-space distillation). The first dichotomy reflects two distinct approaches to avoiding representation collapse. The second may extend CV's recurring complementary-dichotomy pattern into the self-supervision domain, though the underdetermination mechanism that generates complementarity in other CV problems (optical flow, SLAM) has not been directly established as the driver in SSL training signal design.

justifications.label: SSL manifests underdetermination-driven dichotomies across three independent dimensions — the richest single-domain instance

ssl-exhaustive-self-supervision-design-s.text: SSL's exhaustive coverage of the self-supervision design space (three collapse-prevention mechanisms × adversarial/cooperative axis) AND DINOv3's discovery that SSL collapse prevention fails to prevent dense feature degradation together reveal that apparent design-space exhaustion does not guarantee operational completeness — a new axis of failure (global/local spatial granularity) emerged orthogonal to the axes that had been exhaustively explored.

justifications.label: DINOv3 reveals that exhaustive design-space coverage missed an orthogonal failure dimension

ssl-extends-absorption-to-training-metho.text: SSL's extension of the paradigm shift to the supervisory signal itself AND deep learning's specifically absorptive (not destructive) transcendence together demonstrate that the absorptive pattern operates at multiple levels of the learning pipeline: just as CNN absorbed mathematical foundations at the architectural level while replacing hand-designed algorithms, SSL absorbs the inherent structure of data as supervision while replacing externally imposed human annotation — absorption propagating from what is learned (features) to how learning is supervised.

justifications.label: SSL extends the absorptive pattern from architecture to the training methodology level

ssl-extends-paradigm-shift-to-supervisio.text: SSL extends CV's hand-designed-to-learned paradigm shift from algorithms to the supervisory signal itself: not only are feature extraction and recognition learned rather than hand-designed, but the training signal is also self-generated from data structure rather than human annotation — a meta-level application of the same learning-replaces-design principle.

justifications.label: The paradigm shift applies recursively: learned algorithms, then learned supervision for those algorithms

ssl-generates-supervision-from-data-stru.text: Self-supervised learning (SSL) generates its own supervisory signals by exploiting inherent structure, correlations, or metadata within unlabeled data — no external annotation required — sitting between supervised and unsupervised learning.

ssl-methods-span-full-collapse-preventio.text: The SSL negative-example spectrum (contrastive vs non-contrastive) AND the predictive masking spectrum (MAE pixel-space vs JEPA latent-space) AND covariance-based methods (Barlow Twins, VICReg) span three independent axes of SSL design — revealing that collapse prevention and representation quality are achievable through radically different mechanisms (negative examples, architectural asymmetry, covariance constraints, prediction targets).

justifications.label: Three independent SSL design axes demonstrate that representation learning admits multiple sufficient solutions

ssl-negative-example-spectrum.text: Contrastive SSL (requiring both positive and negative pairs) and non-contrastive SSL (positive-only with architectural asymmetry to prevent collapse) span a design spectrum, demonstrating that negative examples are an exchangeable design choice for representation learning — replaceable by architectural constraints.

justifications.label: Two SSL families achieve similar representation quality with opposite stances on negative examples

ssl-noncontrastive-positive-only-asymmet.text: Non-contrastive SSL (e.g., BYOL, DirectPred) uses only positive example pairs and avoids trivial collapse through architectural asymmetry such as an asymmetric predictor network and stop-gradient on the target branch.

ssl-pretext-then-downstream-two-step.text: SSL follows a two-step training process: (1) solve a pretext task using pseudo-labels derived from the data to initialize model parameters, then (2) fine-tune on the actual downstream task using supervised or unsupervised learning.

ssl-reconstructive-distillation-dichotom.text: Self-supervised vision learning's two paradigms — pixel-space masked reconstruction (MAE) and representation-space self-distillation (DINO) — may extend CV's recurring complementary-dichotomy pattern into the self-supervision domain, though the antecedents establish underdetermination as a generative mechanism primarily in optical flow and SLAM rather than directly in SSL training signal design.

justifications.label: SSL's reconstructive vs distillation paradigms are another instance of underdetermination-generated complementary approaches

ssl-three-axis-dichotomy-and-global-loca.text: SSL exhibiting the richest instantiation of underdetermination-generated dichotomies (spanning three independent dimensions: optimization strategy, prediction target, supervision source) AND DINOv3 validating a structural global-local tension in vision SSL (requiring explicit architectural intervention beyond collapse prevention) together suggest that SSL's underdetermination may run deeper than the three-axis analysis alone indicates — beyond generating complementary approaches along multiple axes, there appears to be a spatial granularity tension that is not fully captured by those three axes.

justifications.label: SSL's underdetermination manifests across design axes and spatial granularity simultaneously

ssl-three-axis-dichotomy-is-richest-unde.text: SSL exhibiting complementary dichotomies across at least two independent dimensions (collapse-prevention strategy and prediction target) AND the GAN/diffusion speed-quality tradeoff exhibiting structural analogy to underdetermination-driven complementarity in generation together suggest that the training methodology domain may exhibit a notably rich instantiation of underdetermination-generated complementarity in CV — potentially more axes of valid complementary solutions than individual estimation domains (flow, SLAM, registration each having at most two). However, SSL's third dimension (supervision source) lacks documented antecedent support, and whether generation's complementarity arises from the same underdetermination mechanism as estimation domains, rather than merely resembling it structurally, remains undemonstrated.

justifications.label: SSL and generation together constitute the richest underdetermination domain, exceeding estimation

ssl-training-autonomy-fully-operational-.text: SSL's comprehensive training autonomy (spanning the full collapse-prevention spectrum across contrastive, non-contrastive, masking, and covariance axes) would constitute fully operational self-supervised training if the structural tension between global and local representation quality revealed by DINOv3 were resolved — as long as dense feature degradation can accompany global improvements, SSL autonomy is incomplete at the spatial granularity level.

justifications.label: SSL's training autonomy claim is gated on resolution of the global-local quality divergence DINOv3 exposed

ssl-training-autonomy-structured-by-unde.text: SSL's achievement of training self-sufficiency, combined with the reconstructive/distillation dichotomy that may extend CV's complementary pattern, suggests that training autonomy may itself be shaped by underdetermination: the absence of explicit labels gives rise to complementary self-supervisory approaches (pixel-space MAE vs representation-space DINO) that parallel how mathematical underdetermination generates complementary estimation strategies in classical CV domains like optical flow and SLAM, though the direct role of underdetermination as a generative mechanism in SSL training signal design remains an extension rather than an established finding.

justifications.label: Label absence generates complementary SSL approaches as underdetermination generates estimation approaches

ssl-underdetermination-depth-enables-tra.text: SSL exhibiting the richest instantiation of underdetermination-generated dichotomies (three independent axes plus a spatial granularity tension that may extend beyond those axes) AND achieving learned paradigm training self-sufficiency together suggest that underdetermination's structural depth may facilitate methodological autonomy — a richer dichotomy landscape appears to correlate with a more diversified set of independent paths to self-sufficient training.

justifications.label: SSL's uniquely rich dichotomy structure correlates with its uniquely complete training autonomy, suggesting depth of underdetermination enables degree of self-sufficiency

ssl-vision-spans-reconstructive-and-dist.text: Self-supervised vision learning spans two fundamentally different paradigms: pixel-space masked reconstruction (MAE processing only unmasked 25% of patches) and representation-space self-distillation (DINO with EMA teacher using sharpening and centering), demonstrating visual self-supervision can be grounded in either data-level or representation-level objectives.

justifications.label: MAE (reconstructive) and DINO (distillation) represent complementary SSL paradigms for vision

stability-doubly-bridged-structural-and-.text: CV's paradigm transitions are doubly bridged by independent continuity mechanisms: features provide structural continuity as paradigm-invariant geometric connective tissue, while evaluation co-evolution provides evidential continuity through metrics that measure and confirm preservation — constituting both the mechanism and the measurement of cross-paradigm stability.

justifications.label: Features (structural bridge) and evaluation (evidential bridge) are independent channels through which paradigm stability is simultaneously maintained and verified

stanford-cart-first-autonomous-vehicle.text: The Stanford Cart (late 1970s, Hans Moravec) was the first experimental autonomous vehicle and a precursor to NASA planetary rovers; ALVINN (Carnegie Mellon) was an early neural-network-based autonomous driving system using camera and laser range finder.

statistical-learning-domain-specific-to-.text: Statistical learning in CV includes both domain-specific methods (Eigenface for face recognition, 1990s) and the development of deep CNNs via the Neocognitron→LeNet-5→AlexNet lineage spanning roughly 30 years. Together these illustrate a trajectory from task-specific statistical techniques toward more general learned architectures, though the antecedents do not establish that this constitutes a complete or universal transition from feature engineering to task-agnostic representations.

justifications.label: Eigenface and the CNN lineage bookend statistical learning's evolution from narrow to universal

statistical-learning-recapitulates-field.text: Statistical learning's trajectory from domain-specific methods (Eigenface for face recognition) toward more general learned architectures (the Neocognitron→LeNet-5→AlexNet lineage) parallels CV's broader borrow-then-transcend maturation pattern — the field first borrowed domain-specific statistical techniques, then moved toward more general learned approaches, in a way that echoes the macro-trajectory from external borrowing through hand-designed methods to learned representations. However, this parallel is suggestive rather than exact: the antecedents do not establish that the method-level transition is complete or that it fully recapitulates the macro-level pattern.

justifications.label: The domain-specific→universal arc within statistical learning mirrors the borrow→transcend arc of the entire field — self-similar maturation across scales

steerable-pyramid-orientation-selective.text: The steerable pyramid (Simoncelli) is a multi-scale, multi-orientation bandpass filter bank that adds orientation selectivity to the Laplacian pyramid concept using steerable filters at each level.

stereo-biological-architecture-grounds-c.text: Stereopsis's biological processing streams (coarse/magno = WHERE, fine/parvo = WHAT) mirroring CV's dual-pillar architecture AND stereopsis constituting the deepest biological recapitulation instance together ground CV's dual-pillar macro-structure in the same biological substrate that provides its deepest recapitulation — the field's organizing framework is homologous to the biological architecture it recapitulates.

justifications.label: Stereo's dual processing streams ground CV's dual pillars in the same biology that provides deepest recapitulation

stereo-biological-recapitulation-deepest.text: Stereo vision's biological where/what pathway paralleling CV's own dual-pillar architecture, combined with the biological substrate preceding computation (disparity neurons, random-dot stereograms before any computational stereo), suggests that stereopsis may be a particularly deep instance of CV recapitulating the neural architecture it studies — the field's organizational structure appears to mirror the biological visual system at a fundamental level.

justifications.label: CV's dual-pillar structure recapitulates the biological visual system's dual-pathway architecture, established before computation existed

stereo-biology-grounds-dual-pillars-and-.text: Stereopsis's biological processing streams (coarse/magno = WHERE, fine/parvo = WHAT) ground CV's dual-pillar architecture in a homologous biological substrate, while stereoscopic depth perception is understood across physical, neural, and computational levels. Together, these suggest that CV's fundamental organizational framework draws legitimacy from a biological system that is itself well-characterized across multiple explanatory levels — the dual-pillar structure reflects a biologically grounded architecture rather than mere analogy, though characterizing the biological theory as fully 'computationally complete' goes beyond what the current evidence strictly establishes.

justifications.label: Dual-pillar grounding derives from a computationally complete biological theory, not mere analogy

stereo-depth-complete-computational-theo.text: Stereopsis possesses a complete computational theory spanning neural substrate (disparity-tuned neurons), geometric constraint (horizontal disparity from 6.5cm baseline), and processing-order evidence (random dot stereograms proving depth computed before form recognition).

justifications.label: Neural, geometric, and psychophysical evidence jointly close the explanatory loop for stereopsis

stereo-depth-parallels-cv-where-what-arc.text: Stereo vision's dual-pathway processing — coarse stereopsis via the magnocellular/dorsal 'where' pathway for spatial localization and fine stereopsis via the parvocellular/ventral 'what' pathway for shape and object recognition — presents a notable parallel to CV's broad division between geometric reconstruction and semantic understanding, suggesting the field may partly recapitulate aspects of the neural architecture it studies.

justifications.label: Biological where/what visual pathways structurally mirror CV's geometric/semantic dual pillars

stereo-dual-pathway-prefigures-cv-dual-p.text: Biological stereopsis employs dual-pathway processing — coarse stereopsis via the magnocellular WHERE pathway (spatial localization and relative depth ordering) and fine stereopsis via the parvocellular WHAT pathway (object recognition and depth magnitude judgment) — which presents a structural parallel to CV's separation of geometric reconstruction and semantic understanding, though the analogy is suggestive rather than established at the neuroanatomical level.

justifications.label: The WHERE/WHAT separation in stereo depth processing maps directly onto CV's geometric-pipeline/semantic-understanding dual pillars, tracing the architectural split to its neurobiological origin.

stereo-dual-processing-pathway-mirrors-w.text: Stereopsis divides into coarse (magnocellular/WHERE pathway, ordinal depth) and fine (parvocellular/WHAT pathway, metric depth) processing streams, directly paralleling CV's fundamental WHERE/WHAT architectural division between geometric reconstruction and semantic understanding — the field's macro-structure recapitulates its deepest biological substrate.

justifications.label: Dual stereo pathways instantiate the same WHERE/WHAT principle that structures the field at the architectural level

stereo-processing-streams-mirror-cv-dual.text: The biological dual processing streams for stereopsis — coarse/magnocellular (WHERE/dorsal pathway) and fine/parvocellular (WHAT/ventral pathway) — structurally mirror CV's dual-pillar architecture of geometric reconstruction (WHERE) and semantic understanding (WHAT), grounding the field's macro-structure in biological visual processing.

justifications.label: Biological WHERE/WHAT stereo streams mirror CV's geometric/semantic dual-pillar architecture

stereo-vision-dual-neuroscience-foundati.text: Stereoscopic depth perception has dual neuroscience foundations: Julesz's random dot stereograms (1971) proved perceptually that depth is computed before form recognition, while Barlow et al. (1967) discovered the neural substrate (disparity-tuned neurons in cat visual cortex) — establishing both the computational principle and its biological implementation independently.

justifications.label: Perceptual proof (Julesz) and neural substrate (Barlow) independently establish stereoscopic depth as a pre-attentive, hardware-level computation

stereopsis-biological-substrate-precedes.text: Biological stereo vision discoveries preceded and constrained computational stereo: disparity-tuned neurons (Barlow 1967) provided the neural substrate, random-dot stereograms (Julesz 1971) proved depth is computed before object recognition, and the ~6.5cm inter-ocular baseline physically constrains all stereo geometry — establishing the biological ground truth before computational methods existed.

justifications.label: Three foundational biological stereo discoveries (neural, perceptual, geometric) preceded computational stereo vision

stereopsis-computationally-prior-with-de.text: Stereoscopic depth perception is computationally autonomous from object recognition: it operates before form recognition (random dot stereograms) and is implemented by specialized disparity-tuned neurons, establishing depth as an independent early visual computation.

justifications.label: Neural substrate dedicated to a computation proven independent of form processing

stereopsis-dual-pathway-fine-coarse-reso.text: Stereopsis operates through two functionally and neurally distinct pathways — fine/patent stereopsis (parvocellular "what" pathway, linear depth-disparity, magnitude judgments) and coarse/qualitative stereopsis (magnocellular "where" pathway, ordinal depth order only) — constituting a parallel resolution system rather than a single depth mechanism.

justifications.label: Two independent neural pathways process complementary aspects of the same binocular disparity signal

stereopsis-dual-pathway-maps-to-cortical.text: Stereopsis splits into fine/parvo (quantitative depth magnitude, processed in the parvocellular/ventral stream) and coarse/magno (qualitative depth order, processed in the magnocellular/dorsal stream), directly instantiating the what/where dual-pathway organization of visual cortex at the level of binocular depth processing.

justifications.label: Neuroscientific convergence — the what/where cortical division independently organizes both object recognition AND depth perception

stereopsis-horizontal-disparity-6-5cm.text: Stereopsis derives depth from horizontal binocular disparity caused by the approximately 6.5 cm inter-ocular distance; Wheatstone demonstrated this in 1838 using line stereograms viewed in a stereoscope.

stereopsis-primitive-neural-computation-.text: Barlow's discovery of disparity-tuned neurons (1967) AND Julesz's demonstration that stereoscopic depth precedes form recognition together establish that stereo depth computation is a primitive neural mechanism operating below the level of object recognition, not a higher-order cognitive process.

justifications.label: Neural substrate (dedicated neurons) + behavioral evidence (depth without form) converge on the same conclusion from independent directions: stereopsis is hard-wired, not inferred.

stereoscopic-depth-complete-computationa.text: Stereoscopic depth perception is understood across multiple levels: a physical mechanism (the ~6.5cm inter-ocular baseline generating horizontal disparity, demonstrated by Wheatstone 1838), a neural substrate (disparity-tuned neurons discovered by Barlow et al. 1967 in cat cortex, with later primate evidence from Poggio), and evidence for computational independence from form recognition (Julesz's 1971 random dot stereograms showing depth extraction without monocular form cues).

justifications.label: Three independent lines — physical, neural, and computational — converge on a complete theory

stereoscopic-depth-pre-attentive-computa.text: Julesz's random dot stereograms proving depth perception occurs before form recognition AND disparity-tuned neurons discovered at the earliest cortical stages together establish that stereoscopic depth is a pre-attentive computational primitive — computed at the earliest neural stages as a bottom-up feature rather than a top-down inference.

justifications.label: Two independent lines of evidence (psychophysical and neurophysiological) converge on depth as pre-form computation

structure-tensor-2x2-gradient-product-ma.text: The structure tensor M = [[Σ(Ix²), Σ(IxIy)], [Σ(IxIy), Σ(Iy²)]] is a 2×2 symmetric matrix built from image gradient products summed over a local window, encoding local gradient distribution.

structure-tensor-averageable-angle-not.text: The structure tensor provides an averageable representation of orientation; angle-based orientation representations have discontinuities and are NOT averageable.

structure-tensor-eigenvalues-complete-lo.text: The structure tensor's 2x2 gradient product matrix provides a complete algebraic classifier of local image geometry through its eigenvalue spectrum: both eigenvalues large indicates a corner, one large and one small indicates an edge, both small indicates a flat region.

justifications.label: Eigenvalue analysis of the gradient outer product exhaustively partitions the local geometry space

surface-reconstruction-vertex-vs-volumet.text: Point cloud surface reconstruction follows two approaches: vertex-based methods (Delaunay triangulation, alpha shapes, ball pivoting) that build triangle networks over existing point vertices, and volumetric methods that convert to a voxel distance field then extract the implicit surface via marching cubes.

swin-hierarchical-merging-recapitulates-.text: Swin Transformer's shifted-window attention with hierarchical merging layers (concatenating 2×2 neighboring tokens then projecting, analogous to CNN pooling) and ViT's BERT-like encoder-only architecture together reveal that the most performant vision transformer recovered CNN's hierarchical spatial processing as an internal mechanism — the second-wave absorption of CNN by transformers was not pure elimination but partial recapitulation of the spatial hierarchy it replaced.

justifications.label: Swin's hierarchical design shows transformer absorption of CNN was partially recapitulative

swin-shifted-window-local-attention.text: Swin Transformer uses shifted-window self-attention (local, not global) with hierarchical merging layers that concatenate 2×2 neighboring tokens then project (analogous to CNN pooling), achieving SOTA on COCO object detection.

temporal-and-spatial-bottleneck-arcs-con.text: The structural parallel between the sequence bottleneck arc (vanishing gradients → LSTM → seq2seq bottleneck → attention → transformers) and the spatial depth arc (degradation → ResNet → universal skip connections), together with the evidence that depth-enabling innovations like residual connections were absorbed as universal architectural primitives, suggests that bottleneck-driven innovation is a recurring pattern in which an architectural generation's characteristic pathology drives solutions that can become widely-adopted primitives in subsequent generations.

justifications.label: Bottleneck-driven innovation in both temporal and spatial domains is itself the absorption mechanism

temporal-spatial-convergence-validates-r.text: The residual principle being independently discovered in temporal (LSTM) and spatial (ResNet) domains then universalized across all deep learning AND sequence modeling's limitation-driven evolutionary chain (vanishing gradients → LSTM → seq2seq → attention → transformers) together reveal that the residual principle was not merely convergently discovered but convergently *selected* — it survived the sequence modeling revolution (LSTM's residual survived into transformers) while the gating mechanisms around it were discarded, confirming it addresses optimization geometry rather than domain-specific needs.

justifications.label: Residual principle's survival through the LSTM→transformer transition confirms it as optimization-fundamental

three-classical-methodological-categorie.text: Three structurally distinct categories of classical CV methodology have been traced through absorption into learned architectures: spatial connectivity patterns (skip connections diverging into additive and concatenative roles), global evidence accumulation (Hough voting → correlation → attention), and cascaded quality-control selection (multi-stage filtering → soft parallel weighting). These three parallel absorptive pathways suggest that absorption operated broadly across classical design principles rather than selectively on individual techniques, though the evidence traces specific lineages rather than demonstrating exhaustive coverage of the full classical design vocabulary.

justifications.label: Three independent classical methodological categories all absorbed = comprehensive vocabulary-level absorption, not cherry-picked techniques

three-universal-motifs-achieve-complete-.text: The three universal architectural motifs (attention's cross-field round trip, encoder-decoder's double unity, residual connection's universalization) forming a complete cross-field absorption network AND the learned paradigm's comprehensive self-sufficiency across all dimensions together would constitute complete architectural self-sufficiency — all structural elements needed for any CV task derive from absorbed and universalized primitives.

justifications.label: Architectural self-sufficiency requires that known equivariance gaps and per-scene limitations are resolved

three-universal-motifs-form-complete-cro.text: Attention's complete round trip, jointly traced with the encoder-decoder motif (diachronic generative unity + synchronic task-type unity) and the residual connection motif (depth-enabling internalization-refinement-universalization), reveals at least two complementary absorption pathways — circular cross-pollination and linear internal distillation — operating at multiple levels of architectural abstraction, suggesting these represent key structural channels through which absorption propagates between CV and NLP.

justifications.label: Three motifs (attention, encoder-decoder, residual) each independently trace cross-field absorption; their joint operation covers the full space of architectural innovation transfer (computational primitive, structural template, depth-enabling scaffold).

three-wave-absorption-trajectory.text: CV exhibits what can be characterized as a multi-wave absorption trajectory: first-wave absorption (CNNs internalizing classical mathematical foundations while replacing hand-designed algorithms), second-wave absorption (transformers eliminating CNN's domain-specific components like convolution and anchors), and recursive within-paradigm absorption (neural rendering converging on explicit representations). The evidence suggests each wave absorbs and selectively retains innovations from its predecessor, and that this pattern recurs within paradigms as well as across them.

justifications.label: Three structurally distinct absorption waves (classical→CNN, CNN→transformer, within-learned recursion) define CV's absorption trajectory

three-wave-trajectory-and-classical-abso.text: The three-wave absorption trajectory (CNN absorbing classical math → transformers absorbing CNN innovations → neural rendering converging on explicit representations) AND the comprehensive absorption of three structurally distinct classical methodological categories (spatial connectivity patterns, global evidence accumulation, cascaded quality-control selection) jointly suggest that a substantial portion of CV's classical methodological inventory has been processed through the absorptive dynamic — covering multiple independent design traditions rather than selectively absorbing individual techniques.

justifications.label: Temporal waves and methodological categories independently confirm exhaustive absorption

three-wave-trajectory-instantiates-mutua.text: The three-wave absorption trajectory (CNN absorbing math, transformers absorbing CNN innovations, neural rendering converging on explicit representations) illustrates a pattern consistent with mutual reinforcement between recapitulation and absorption: each successive wave deepens absorption while following a maturation pattern that parallels earlier waves, suggesting these two principles may operate in tandem across CV's evolution — though the specific causal mechanism by which recapitulation validates absorption's universality at every scale is not directly established by the evidence.

justifications.label: Each absorption wave simultaneously recapitulates maturation at a new level

thresholding-strategies-dual-adaptive-me.text: Hysteresis thresholding (Canny's dual-threshold edge continuation) and Otsu's inter-class variance maximization represent two complementary adaptive thresholding strategies: hysteresis uses spatial connectivity to bridge weak evidence into strong decisions, while Otsu uses statistical distribution structure to find optimal binary partitions — both avoiding the fragility of fixed single thresholds through different notions of context (spatial vs. statistical).

justifications.label: Canny's spatial-connectivity adaptation and Otsu's statistical-distribution adaptation as dual threshold resolution strategies

training-and-mathematical-autonomy-joint.text: The learned paradigm appears to achieve substantial methodological independence through two complementary dimensions: training autonomy (SSL and diffusion jointly reducing major external dependencies on labels and sequential noise across complementary dimensions) AND a form of mathematical self-sufficiency (diffusion's tractable overdetermination across equivalent formalisms contributing to both practical computability and theoretical robustness) — suggesting systematic self-sufficiency in both data requirements and mathematical foundations.

justifications.label: Data independence (training autonomy) and mathematical independence (formal self-sufficiency) are orthogonal dimensions of complete methodological autonomy

training-autonomy-and-architectural-infr.text: The learned paradigm's methodological independence through training autonomy and mathematical self-sufficiency (SSL + diffusion jointly eliminating external dependencies) AND the encoder-decoder skeleton plus depth enablers constituting major infrastructural layers of learned CV together demonstrate self-sufficiency at two orthogonal levels: the training/methodology level (how models learn) and the architectural/structural level (what models are built from). However, the architectural level represents foundational but not exhaustive coverage, as other architectural contributions (attention mechanisms, normalization variants, learned optimization components) also play significant roles — so while neither level alone would constitute paradigm completeness, the two together establish core self-sufficiency rather than total self-sufficiency.

justifications.label: Methodological and architectural self-sufficiency are orthogonal dimensions of paradigm completeness

training-autonomy-completes-learned-para.text: SSL and augmentation jointly achieving training autonomy (self-supervision + self-regularization) AND the learned paradigm's simultaneously integrative and generative character (resolving dichotomies rather than adjudicating them) together suggest the learned paradigm has achieved comprehensive self-sufficiency — it not only generates its own solutions (integration) but generates its own training signals and regularization.

justifications.label: Training autonomy extends the learned paradigm's integrative character from architecture to the training pipeline itself

training-inference-asymmetry-and-ssl-joi.text: Training-inference asymmetry spanning both regularization (batch norm's dual statistics, augmentation's training-only application) and self-supervision (SSL's training self-sufficiency), combined with SSL's training autonomy being structured by underdetermination (the reconstructive/distillation dichotomy extending CV's complementary pattern), suggest that underdetermination may function as an organizing principle not only for CV's problem structure but also for its learning regimes — the same mathematical property that generates complementary estimation strategies appears to also generate complementary training strategies.

justifications.label: Underdetermination's structuring role extends from estimation problems to training methodology design

training-inference-asymmetry-as-underdet.text: Batch normalization's dual-statistics regime (per-batch at training, population at inference) and augmentation's training-time-only constraint illustrate a recurring pattern of training-inference asymmetry in deep learning — both techniques introduce variability or expanded coverage during training that is removed or absent at deployment, suggesting that the optimization process may benefit from different statistical conditions than those used for final evaluation.

justifications.label: Both regularization mechanisms impose training-time noise that inference removes, reflecting a systematic asymmetry in how underdetermined learning is stabilized

training-inference-asymmetry-spans-regul.text: Batch normalization's dual-statistics regime (batch statistics at training, population statistics at inference) and augmentation's training-time-only constraint jointly establish a systematic training-inference asymmetry in regularization, while SSL's training self-sufficiency (generating supervision from data structure alone) demonstrates that key aspects of the learned paradigm's training methodology — from regularization through supervision — can operate under conditions deliberately distinct from deployment conditions. Together, these suggest a pattern where training-time conditions in the learned paradigm are often designed to differ from inference-time conditions, though the scope and necessity of this asymmetry may vary across techniques.

justifications.label: Training-inference asymmetry extends from regularization mechanics to the supervision source itself

training-self-sufficiency-fully-operatio.text: SSL and augmentation jointly achieving training autonomy (self-supervision + self-regularization) AND training-inference asymmetry spanning regularization and SSL (both imposing training-time variability absent at inference) together suggest that the learned paradigm's training self-sufficiency is fully operational — self-generated supervision, self-generated regularization, and a principled training-inference separation constitute a complete self-sustaining training methodology — UNLESS the global-local tension identified in SSL (DINOv3) reveals that spatial coherence breaks the self-sufficiency claim.

justifications.label: Training self-sufficiency is fully operational unless SSL's global-local tension breaks spatial coherence

transfer-learning-different-domain-or-ta.text: Transfer learning applies when source and target differ in either domain (feature space X or marginal distribution P(X)) or task (label space Y or predictive function f), reusing source knowledge to improve target performance.

transfer-learning-dual-improvement-unles.text: Transfer learning improves both initial performance (over random initialization) and final asymptotic performance when source and target differ in domain or task — unless the source knowledge actively degrades target task performance (negative transfer), as demonstrated by Zoph et al. (2020) showing pre-training can hurt with sufficient target data.

justifications.label: The dual improvement guarantee holds conditionally on source-target compatibility

transfer-learning-first-paper-bozinovski.text: The first paper on transfer learning in neural networks was by Bozinovski and Fulgosi in 1976; Andrew Ng at NIPS 2016 predicted transfer learning would be the next major driver of ML commercial success after supervised learning.

transfer-learning-formalizes-borrow-then.text: Transfer learning's formalization of cross-domain knowledge transfer and CV's borrow-then-transcend maturation pattern share a structural resemblance: the field's development — borrowing from psychology, photogrammetry, and biology before transcending those borrowings with learned approaches — can be seen as analogous to transfer learning's source-to-target domain adaptation. This parallel suggests the field may have informally enacted a process resembling the knowledge-transfer mechanism it later formalized as a technique.

justifications.label: Transfer learning provides a formal framework for understanding CV's own meta-level borrowing trajectory

transfer-learning-improves-initial-and-a.text: Transfer learning improves both initial performance (compared to random weight initialization) and final asymptotic performance after training on the target task.

transfer-learning-reflexively-validates-.text: Transfer learning's structural resemblance to CV's borrow-then-transcend maturation pattern, combined with the retrospective observation that borrowed foundations (optic flow, bundle adjustment) survived the paradigm shift intact, suggests a form of mutual reinforcement in CV's methodological development: the borrowing strategy appears validated both by analogy to a formal knowledge-transfer mechanism and by the empirical resilience of the specific borrowed content through a major methodological transition.

justifications.label: Borrowing is validated both by transfer learning theory (why it works) and by paradigm survival (that it worked)

transformer-eliminates-cv-domain-specifi.text: Transformers systematically eliminated domain-specific hand-designed components across multiple CV tasks: ViT replaced convolutional feature hierarchies with generic patch tokenization, DETR eliminated anchors and NMS in object detection, and Swin restored computational tractability through shifted-window locality — each removing a different category of CV-specific inductive bias.

justifications.label: Three transformer architectures each eliminated a distinct category of hand-designed CV component

transformer-introduced-2017-vaswani.text: The Transformer architecture was introduced by Vaswani et al. in 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017), replacing sequential recurrence with parallel self-attention and becoming the foundation for BERT, GPT, T5, and vision transformers.

transformer-second-wave-absorption-elimi.text: Transformers systematically eliminating CV domain-specific components (ViT replacing convolution, DETR removing anchors/NMS, Swin restoring tractability) AND attention's status as a mature second-generation absorption mechanism together constitute a second wave of absorption — the first wave (CNN) absorbed mathematical foundations; the second wave (transformer) absorbs CNN's own domain-specific inductive biases.

justifications.label: Transformer-based CV represents a second absorption wave that internalizes CNN-era components just as CNN internalized classical mathematics

transformer-universal-cv-architecture-ca.text: Transformers' systematic elimination of domain-specific components in both feature extraction (ViT replacing convolutions with patch tokens) and detection (DETR eliminating anchors and NMS) positions them as candidates for a universal CV architecture that replaces CNN-specific inductive biases with generic sequence modeling, unless ViTs' lower data efficiency relative to CNNs prevents adoption outside large-data regimes.

justifications.label: Two independent CV tasks restructured by transformers suggests universality, gated by data efficiency gap

transpose-convolution-checkerboard-artif.text: Transpose convolution (deconvolution) is prone to checkerboard artifacts; the fix is to upscale then convolve instead.

triple-anchoring-extends-to-next-paradig.text: CV's triply anchored paradigm shift — stabilized by mathematical invariance, biological continuity, and evaluative rigor — would extend its preservative character to the next paradigm transition (e.g., foundation models replacing task-specific architectures) if the translation equivariance gap in CNN's biological design lineage were resolved, ensuring the biological anchor remains fully load-bearing.

justifications.label: Future paradigm resilience depends on the biological anchor's integrity — the equivariance gap threatens the specific lineage that makes absorption possible

two-stage-detectors-propose-then-classif.text: Two-stage detectors (R-CNN family) first propose candidate regions then classify each region, while one-stage detectors (YOLO, SSD) predict boxes and classes in a single pass.

underdetermination-achieves-explanatory-.text: Mathematical underdetermination would achieve complete explanatory closure — simultaneously grounding CV's completeness concretely (the specific mathematical structures that instantiate the inverse difficulty) AND driving the preservation dynamic that maintained stability across paradigm shifts (difficulty→borrowing→paradigm-invariance cycle) — constituting a self-sufficient causal-epistemic account of the field's entire trajectory.

justifications.label: Underdetermination grounds both completeness and stability from a single mathematical source, but the linearization assumptions it necessitated break under real conditions, preventing full closure

underdetermination-drives-preservation-d.text: Mathematical underdetermination — the aperture problem's one-equation-two-unknowns and SLAM's observation model constraints — is the proximate mathematical driver of the inverse problem's self-reinforcing preservation dynamic: specific underdetermined equations forced adoption of regularization frameworks and external mathematical structures, which then became paradigm-invariant anchors, which ensured the revolution would absorb rather than discard them — a causal chain from concrete equations to field-level preservation.

justifications.label: Concrete underdetermined equations are the proximate mathematical cause of the abstract preservation dynamic

underdetermination-generates-and-resolve.text: Underdetermination appears to function as both a generative mechanism and a constraint on resolution form in CV: it generates complementary dichotomies (as seen in optical flow's local/global split and SLAM's paradigm proliferation) and the resulting dichotomies appear to require integration rather than selection for resolution. This suggests underdetermination may drive a generative-and-resolution pattern, though the evidence comes from a limited set of domains and the structural analogy between them may not be exact.

justifications.label: Underdetermination is both universal dichotomy generator and universal resolution-mode determiner

underdetermination-generates-complementa.text: Mathematical underdetermination appears to be a primary generative mechanism behind several of CV's recurring complementary dichotomies: the aperture problem's one-equation-two-unknowns drove the local/global regularization dichotomy in optical flow, and SLAM's joint pose-map estimation challenge has led to paradigm proliferation (EKF/GraphSLAM/Active SLAM). In both cases, mathematical insufficiency appears to have encouraged the generation of complementary methods rather than single dominant solutions, though the structural analogy between these domains may not be exact.

justifications.label: Underdetermination causally explains why CV generates complementary rather than competing solutions; root cause identification linking mathematical structure to field-level pattern

underdetermination-generates-dichotomies.text: Underdetermination generates the complementary dichotomies that structure CV's subfields (forcing multiple valid resolution strategies rather than single solutions) AND the learned paradigm integrates those same underdetermination-grounded dichotomies rather than adjudicating them — underdetermination is simultaneously the source of CV's characteristic multiplicity and the reason that resolution required integration rather than selection.

justifications.label: Underdetermination creates the dichotomies AND determines that integration (not selection) is the structurally appropriate resolution

underdetermination-grounds-completeness-.text: CV's completeness claim is grounded not just in abstract inverse-problem logic but in concrete mathematical underdetermination: the same aperture-problem and SLAM constraints that instantiate inverse difficulty also drive the preservation dynamic that produced triple anchoring, which scaffolded completeness.

justifications.label: Two independent paths trace completeness back to the same concrete underdetermination
